rationale: The English reconstruction preserves the culinary meaning of the multilingual original: six ramekins, all six ingredients and quantities, hot half-height water bath, 150 °C oven, 15-minute warm infusion, low-foam mixing criterion, 35–45 minute bake and wobble endpoint, cooled custards, and the thin amber brittle sugar crust. Portioning into ramekins and cooling are explicit renderings of the six-ramekin bake context and the original cooled-custards output, not materially new recipe facts.
